About the Position

EPFL's School of Life Sciences Summer Research Program places bachelor's and master's students in EPFL laboratories on Lake Geneva for a paid summer of research. The application window for the 2027 edition typically opens in November and closes in early December 2026, in line with recent editions.

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

EPFL's School of Life Sciences Summer Research Program places bachelor's and master's students in EPFL laboratories on Lake Geneva for a paid summer of research. The application window for the 2027 edition typically opens in November and closes in early December 2026, in line with recent editions.

Programme Highlights

  • Eight-week paid research internship in world-class EPFL labs
  • Stipend plus accommodation and travel assistance
  • Strong stepping stone toward EPFL doctoral admissions
  • Applications cluster in a short November-December window

Who Should Apply

Second- and third-year bachelor students and master's students in life sciences and related fields, with strong academic records and lab interest.

Funding and Costs

Paid internship with accommodation assistance and travel support per the programme's standard package.

Deadline and How to Apply

Watch the EPFL SV Summer Research Program page and submit through the online form as soon as the 2027 window opens. Key deadline information: Application window for summer 2027 typically opens in November and closes in early December 2026 — confirm on the SV SRP page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About EPFL

EPFL (Ecole Polytechnique Federale de Lausanne) is one of Europe's leading technical universities on the Lake Geneva shore. Its doctoral programs - including the EDBB in biotechnology and bioengineering - employ doctoral candidates on Swiss contracts and concentrate research across engineering, life sciences and physical sciences.

Official website: https://www.epfl.ch

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Typically opens November - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
